blurb: TipToe Sailing offers private sailboat ceremonies such as scattering ashes at sea and burial at sea with customizable readings and music. They provide multi-day sailing tours along the Southern California coast with activities like snorkeling, fishing, and kayaking. The company also delivers sailboats and powerboats worldwide with USCG certified captains.
extraNote: Burial at sea requires permits and compliance with local, national, and environmental laws; family must verify legal requirements before booking · Flexible scheduling, available daily · Public dock, Los Angeles, CA 90731
